name: revenue-firestore-rules-tests
description: Unit tests for firestore.rules, run against the Firestore emulator.

scripts.//test: Assumes an emulator is already listening. Use `npm run emulate`.
scripts.//emulate: The whole suite: start an emulator, run the tests, shut it down, exit with the suite's code. It calls the LOCAL firebase binary on purpose — a standalone (pkg-bundled) firebase CLI puts its own Node 20 on the child process's PATH, and that Node cannot require() vitest's ESM entry point. Same family as the npm --prefix problem documented in firebase.json.
scripts.emulate: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project revenue-rules-test --config ../../firebase.json "npx vitest run"
